notes: 📋 Signal report card — a careful audit and clean-up of how warnings read. The edge shown on a warning line (📉 Quiet selling? and the down-day splits) now reads in the warning's OWN direction — a positive number means the warning worked (price fell), matching the money line just below it, instead of clashing signs on the same card. A warning's win-rate now says the honest thing — '% lagged the market' (underperforming IS the warning working), never '% beat the market' (which for a warning means it FAILED). The ladder tooltip's edge now matches its money column. 📉 Dist? is renamed 📉 Quiet selling? everywhere, so the card, ladder and nursery all use the one name the radar tile and lessons already show. Under the hood: a warning that held up across older eras is no longer wrongly downgraded — grading numbers are unchanged, only the labels and one era check were corrected. Display and wording only; no pick maths moved.
